mapper.select: SELECT toc.FNUMBER ORG_ID--,TOC.FNAME_L2 ,tbc.FISOCODE CURRENCY_TYPE,ga.FNUMBER ACCOUNT_CODE--ga.FNAME_L2 ,SUM(gb.FBEGINBALANCEFOR) FBEGINBALANCEFOR,SUM(gb.FENDBALANCEFOR) FENDBALANCEFOR FROM HXORACLE.T_GL_ACCOUNTBALANCE_5F gb LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GA ON GB.FACCOUNTID = GA.FID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc ON toc.FID =gb.FORGUNITID LEFT OUTER JOIN HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc ON gb.FCURRENCYID =tbc.FID WHERE gb.FPERIOD =#{periodCode} AND toc.FNUMBER IN ('01-C0001','02-C0001','80001','30001') GROUP BY gb.FPERIOD ,toc.FNUMBER ,ga.FNUMBER ,tbc.FISOCODE ORDER BY toc.FNUMBER,ga.FNUMBER
